commit.subject: LU-21340 quota: unlock lqe_glbl_data_lock on early return
commit.message:
LU-21340 quota: unlock lqe_glbl_data_lock on early return

qmt_clear_lgeg_arr_nu() returned false without mutex_unlock() when
qmt_map_lge_idx() failed, leaving the global lqe's lqe_glbl_data_lock
held and blocking every later user of that lqe.

Fixes: 1f9689d0f92e ("LU-17770 quota: don't panic in qmt_map_lge_idx")
